name: TENAGA
recent: Tenaga Nasional 近期与 IOI Corp 及中小企业财团签署合资协议，共同开发 500MW 太阳能项目。同时，公司持续获得公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）的股权变动申报。新闻方面，公司强调加强电网现代化以支持马来西亚经济。
notable: 与 IOI Corp 旗下 Luminous Aspect 及 CSP 500MW 签署合资股东协议，开发 500MWac 太阳能光伏项目，并配备 250MW/1,000MWh 电池储能系统。
新闻报导公司优先加强电网建设，以支持马来西亚经济确定性。
新闻报导公司参与 Negeri Sembilan 500MW 太阳能项目开发。
risks: 公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）近期多次申报股权变动，需关注其持股变化。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为182.36亿令吉，环比增长6.6%，同比增长8.3%；净利为8.888亿令吉，环比下降19.0%，同比下降23.3%；净利率为4.9%，低于上一季度的6.4%。

recent_en: Tenaga Nasional recently signed a joint venture agreement with IOI Corp and a consortium of SMEs to develop a 500MW solar project. Meanwhile, the company continued to receive shareholding change notifications from EPF and KWAP. In the news, the company emphasized grid modernization to support Malaysia's economy.
notable_en: Signed a joint venture shareholders' agreement with IOI Corp's Luminous Aspect and CSP 500MW to develop a 500MWac solar PV project with a 250MW/1,000MWh battery energy storage system.
News reported the company prioritizes grid strengthening to support Malaysia's economic certainty.
News reported the company's involvement in developing a 500MW solar project in Negeri Sembilan.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP have recently made multiple shareholding change notifications; their stake changes warrant attention.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 18.236 billion, up 6.6% QoQ and 8.3% YoY; net income was MYR 888.8 million, down 19.0% QoQ and 23.3% YoY; net margin was 4.9%, lower than 6.4% in the previous quarter.
